# openaiagents_vault (Resource)

An Agents API vault for MCP credentials. The inspected API has no vault update operation; changing `name` or `metadata` replaces the vault. Deleting a vault removes its credentials remotely. This provider does not enumerate or terminate sessions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openaiagents_vault" "shared" {
  name = "shared-mcp"
  metadata = {
    purpose = "deployment"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `metadata` (Map of String) String metadata. Changes force replacement because no vault update API is documented.
- `name` (String) Vault name. Changes force replacement because no vault update API is documented.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix create timestamp.
- `id` (String) Remote vault ID.
- `object` (String) Object type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openaiagents_vault.shared vault_abc123
```
